name: County-Level US Corn Yield Lead-Time Forecasting
description: Initial release Code supporting the paper How Early Can a Corn Yield Forecast Be Trusted? This repository provides the lead-time forecasting framework, experimental code, and reproducible benchmark. Included Public-data pipeline for rebuilding the county-year modeling matrix Reproducible benchmark for the paper tables and figures Six-date lead-time experiments from April through harvest Model comparisons and cumulative feature-group ablations USDA crop-condition contribution experiments Leave-one-year-out, walk-forward, and leave-one-state-out validation Paired significance tests and leakage audits The associated modeling matrix is available separately on Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22133245
